quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei DOTI Micro Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Products (annual report, 2025): imaging optical components RMB 582,710,189.84 (+26.82%, 66.44% of revenue, gross margin 26.36%, up 1.41 points); communications optical components RMB 270,873,320.32 (+118.46%, 30.89% of revenue, gross margin 19.70%, down 1.93 points); other revenue RMB 23,433,367.41; overall gross margin 24.31%; domestic sales 99.34% of revenue. The company says its communications business expanded from the telecom to the datacom market in 2025: the optical isolator product line was completed and is in batch delivery to some customers, with current capacity able to match customer orders; WDM filters and other high-end products were sampled or shipped in small batches; TO caps ship in volume; Z-block assemblies and turning prisms are in development and market promotion.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei DOTI Micro Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report): the company calls communications optics its core strategic segment. In 2026 it will focus on ramping optical isolator capacity and yield (expanding capacity by optimising lines and adding staff), move WDM filters, Z-block assemblies, prisms and optical assemblies from sampling to volume shipment and raise their share of communications revenue, and invest in components for 1.6T/3.2T modules (higher-performance WDM filters, more integrated and miniaturised Z-blocks) and in Faraday rotator materials (crystal preparation). It will advance the Nanchang base, adjusting the expansion pace for isolators and spin-coated filters to demand; in imaging it will defend its spin-coated filter share and build the phone micro-prism line. It says global Faraday rotator supply is tight and China's rare-earth export controls widen the gap; it has contingency plans and is cultivating diversified supply. Management says it is confident and that the dual-engine pattern is expected to lift overall results to a new level.
